card.name: Punctuation closing a medical list or clause
card.fires_on: Closing parentheses, commas, periods and spaces that end a medical clause or list in drug labels, often just before a stated risk, such as ketoacidosis, or a number. Also fires partway through words like Prescribing and Precautions.

modes.label: Closing bracket or comma
modes.description: A closing parenthesis or comma ending a list of conditions just before a statement about risk.
modes.example: Type 2 diabetes mellitus and pancreatic disorders (e.g., history of pancreatitis or pancreatic surgery<<)>> are also risk factors for ketoacidosis

modes.label: Period or space after a clause
modes.description: A sentence-ending period or a space inside a number range or unit expression.
